definitions.explanation: The act or method of blocking sound from passing through walls, floors, or other barriers. A technical term used in construction, architecture, and acoustics.

examples.japanese: {遮音|しゃおん}{性能|せいのう}が{高|たか}い{壁|かべ}。
examples.english: A wall with high sound insulation performance.

examples.japanese: このマンションは{遮音|しゃおん}がしっかりしている。
examples.english: This apartment building has solid soundproofing.

examples.japanese: {録音|ろくおん}スタジオでは{遮音|しゃおん}と{吸音|きゅうおん}の{両方|りょうほう}が{必要|ひつよう}だ。
examples.english: In a recording studio, both sound insulation and sound absorption are needed.

notes: Composed of {遮|しゃ} (block, intercept) + {音|おん} (sound). Refers specifically to blocking sound transmission, as opposed to {吸音|きゅうおん} (sound absorption, which reduces echo) and {防音|ぼうおん} (soundproofing, the general term). Common collocations: {遮音|しゃおん}{性|せい} (sound insulation properties), {遮音|しゃおん}{材|ざい} (sound insulation material), {遮音|しゃおん}{等級|とうきゅう} (sound insulation rating). An important concept when apartment hunting in Japan — {遮音|しゃおん}{等級|とうきゅう} ratings indicate how well floors and walls block noise between units.
